title: Back Sleeping Halved SIDS, But Thousands Still Die
hook: A safer sleep position transformed infant survival without ending the danger.
closing: Putting babies on their backs remains a simple step parents can use tonight.
question: Do new parents know this rule?

segments.say: The SIDS rate fell to 0.64 per thousand births by 2008. Back sleeping accompanied a drop of more than half.
Before the campaign, 85.4% of SIDS cases involved stomach-down placement. Sleep position became the prevention target.
About 3,400 sleep-related infant deaths still occur yearly. The improvement did not erase the need for safer sleep.
